colors: Black chamfered housing with a large RoboMaster 'R' logo on top; an LED light bar on each of the 4 sides: solid red/blue normally, flashing red/blue on a valid card, white when a card is written, yellow on error.
notes: 13.56 MHz ISO15693 reader, 100 mm range, 5 V 100 mA. Mounted face-down under the chassis.
